title: Packed monomials
text: A monomial's exponents are packed into one machine word, with the first generator in the most significant bits. For x^3*y^2 in two generators with 32-bit fields, the word is 3 << 32 + 2. Variables are made with @syms, or with Sym from a name. Numbers stay exact: Sym makes an exact number, and arithmetic with symbols keeps integers and rationals exact. @syms x y z
